articles.summary: SAVANNAH, Ga. , April 25, 2014 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Citi Trends, Inc. (Nasdaq:CTRN) today announced details for the release of its results for the first quarter ending May 3, 2014 . Citi Trends plans to release its earnings for the first quarter before the market opens on Wednesday, May 21, 2014 .
articles.title: Citi Trends Sets Date for First Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call
